title: 第21章 教训赵瑞晨第22章 报到
content_zh:
赵瑞晨很是得意，目光逐一扫视而过。刚才高山的话语让在场众人都有些复杂，有畏惧，也有厌恶。学业不易，谁没有想到赵瑞晨竟然如此的险恶，直接断人前程。可他们也都没有办法。各人自扫门前雪，哪管他人瓦上霜。
唯独叶岚不怕，冷哼一声道：“真让人恶心。高山，我们走了，这里有些人让我觉得肮脏。”
谁都知道叶岚说的是谁，赵瑞晨的脸色一下就难看起来，他旁边的雯雯如同是被踩了尾巴一样，顿时就跳了出来，厉声道：“叶岚，你算什么东西，真以为自己多漂亮就牛了是吧。你恶心谁啊，你肮脏谁啊。一副圣母婊的样子，还不知道是什么货色呢。”
赵瑞晨也沉声道：“叶岚，你这是执意跟我过不去了是么？我就不明白了。就这么一个货色，哪里让你觉得好了。我赵瑞晨怎么就配不上你了？论学识，我年年拿奖学金。现在已经可以主刀普外的手术了。论家世，就咱们东河市的房价，给他高山十年都不一定买得起。你鼻子不是鼻子，脸不是脸，你真以为我赵瑞晨没有你活不下去了是么？记住了，高山的今天，说不定就是你的明天。你还没让我赵瑞晨走不动道。”
原本今天就憋了一肚子气，此刻被高山和叶岚这么一撩拨。赵瑞晨也不再文质彬彬了。心一横，本来就追不到手了，那就直接撕破脸算了。直接对着叶岚喷了起来。
将心比心的说，赵瑞晨真称得上是天之骄子一类的人物，家世好，自身也不差，医技水平也是响当当的。因为家里的背景，实习期间的老师也都放手让他做，技术水平提升很快，据说都已经内定留院工作了，只等毕业答辩之后就可以接着上医学院的心外科硕博连读。这样的人，未来的前程是远大的。谈不上什么羡慕不羡慕。人就是如此，抛开那些不学无术的纨绔不谈，有的人，天生起步就比一般人要高。这是生的好。这就是命。
“可你心性人品不好。”高山淡然的说出这句话，同时，高山突然伸手搂住了叶岚的肩膀，叶岚刹那间颤抖了一下却没有反对。
高山沉声道：“叶岚是很单纯的一个人。她或许从来都没有想过什么男男女女的事情。而跟我能聊的来，也不过是因为我很自然，我没有邪念而已。可你却把我当成了眼中钉、肉中刺；你以为你是谁啊？恋爱自由，哪怕是父母都无法干涉吧。正因为如此，实际上岚岚反而因为这种逆反心理，而被你一步步的推向了我。要不然，你怎么处心积虑的把我弄出附二院呢。只可惜啊，如果我不想走，今天林院长在场，你也好，冯忠华也好，恐怕还真没有办法把我赶走。”
说到这，高山走到了赵瑞晨的前面，脸上写满了不屑，拍了拍赵瑞晨的衣服，道：“真以为你有多么牛逼啊。不过是配合你一下而已。就觉得自己天下第一了。记住，是你山爷我自己看不上附二院。而不是附二院不要我。”
叶岚痴了，看着高山，神情莫名的有些复杂。心中却是涌出了一种知己的感觉。她望向高山的目光有了一些变化，因为高山懂她。
赵瑞晨一看到叶岚这种痴迷的眼光，立刻就不舒服了，冷笑道：“是啊，可惜你是白痴啊。还偏偏选择了学中医。我倒要看看你能混出什么名堂来。”
高山此刻是气死人不偿命，轻轻一笑：“混不出不要紧啊。我有程老关照啊。还能差到哪里去呢。再说了，我还得感谢你呢，要不然岚岚怎么能看上我。”
这话说的有些大言不惭了，甚至有些过分了。因为高山此刻有拿着叶岚当工具在炫耀的感觉。可在此情此景之下，尤其在赵瑞晨这种即将爆发的情况之下，就不是那么显眼了。
哪怕是叶岚，也被高山接二连三的这种露骨话语，说得有些心慌意乱，根本就没在意高山说什么。
“我去你妈的！”
赵瑞晨一声怒吼，在高山的撩拨之下，终于是按捺不住心中的怒吼，挥舞着拳头朝着高山冲了过来。
随着他这一动，跟在他身后的几个男生里面，其中有两个也跟着冲了上来。高山嘴角一翘。忍不住动手了么？别说三个人了，五个他都不怕。
别说高山修炼了《太初养生经》，即便没有，从小在农村锻炼的高山也不是赵瑞晨这些温室花朵可以比拟的。如果是混社会的初中生或者是技校生这种。高山还会有所担忧。这群孩子可不会管你什么人，拿上刀就是干，他们可真敢捅。可眼前这几个不同，这些人就是样子吓人而已。
南雅医学院怎么说都是国家一类重点本科，能进这里的，且不说都是乖乖孩子，至少也是学习不差的好学生。大学几年虽然有所锻炼，可终归也是学生。一般人打架，迎上去就会闭着眼睛挥舞拳头。至于拳头打在哪里，怎么在打，其实那都是乱打。
可高山不同，高山很冷静，看准时机，伸出脚，卡住其中一人，包厢地面上到处都是酒水，湿滑不堪，就这么绊一下，立刻就让其中一人摔倒在地。同时一个转身，恰好顺着另外一人的手臂而去。

就好像是那人伸着手专门在等着他一样。而高山整个人压着，直接就让对方转了一个方向。
同时，高山双手向前，迎着赵瑞晨的拳头而来，一抓一扣，一只手扣住了赵瑞晨的左手，一个扭动。赵瑞晨就哀嚎了一下，他的左手已经到了背后，整个人都跟着弯曲下去了。紧接着，高山的另外一只手也抓住了赵瑞晨的右肩膀。一脚抬起，踩在了赵瑞晨的膝盖处，直接让赵瑞晨跪了下去。
“来啊！”高山一声怒吼，瞪大的眼睛看着对方蠢蠢欲动的两人，道：“敢动一下，就让他躺下去！”
别说赵瑞晨带的这几个乌合之众了。哪怕是混社会的大佬被控制了，小弟们在找到好机会之前也不敢轻举妄动啊。
高山手指用力，这是一种手法。实际高山是按住了赵瑞晨的穴位，这一下就直接让赵瑞晨惨叫起来。那种胀痛是他根本无法忍受的。
“姓高的。有种你就杀了我。”在这种剧痛的间隙，赵瑞晨咬牙切齿的说了起来。
content_en:
Zhao Ruichen was very proud and glanced at them one by one. Gao Shan's words just now made everyone present feel a little complicated, with fear and disgust. Studying is not easy, and no one would have thought that Zhao Ruichen could be so sinister, directly ruining his future. But there was nothing they could do. Everyone sweeps the snow in front of their own door, not caring about the frost on other people's tiles.
Only Ye Lan was not afraid and snorted coldly: "It's really disgusting. Gao Shan, let's go. There are some people here who make me feel dirty."
Everyone knew who Ye Lan was talking about. Zhao Ruichen's face suddenly turned ugly. Wenwen next to him jumped out as if her tail had been stepped on, and said sternly: "Ye Lan, who do you think you are? You really think you are awesome because of your beauty, don't you? Who are you disgusting? Who are you filthy? You look like a virgin bitch, you don't know what you are."
Zhao Ruichen also said in a deep voice: "Ye Lan, are you determined to get along with me? I don't understand. How can you feel good about such a thing? How come I, Zhao Ruichen, am not worthy of you? In terms of knowledge, I get scholarships every year. Now I can perform general surgery." Shi, given the housing prices in Donghe City, Gao Shan may not be able to afford it for ten years. Your nose is not a nose, and your face is not a face. Do you really think that I, Zhao Ruichen, can't survive without you? Remember, Gao Shan's today may be your tomorrow."
I had been holding back my anger today, but now I was provoked by Gao Shan and Ye Lan. Zhao Ruichen is no longer polite. If your heart is broken, you can't catch her in the first place, so just break up with her. He sprayed directly at Ye Lan.
Comparatively speaking, Zhao Ruichen can truly be regarded as a person like the favored son of heaven. He has a good family background, is not bad himself, and his medical skills are also reputable. Because of his family background, the teachers during his internship also let him do it, and his technical level improved quickly. It is said that he has already been assigned to work in the hospital. He only needs to wait for his graduation defense to continue his master's and doctoral studies in cardiac surgery at the medical school. Such people have a bright future. There is no talk of envy or envy. That's just how people are. Putting aside those uneducated dudes, some people are born with a higher starting point than the average person. This is raw and well made. This is life.
"But you have a bad character." Gao Shan said this calmly. At the same time, Gao Shan suddenly put his arm around Ye Lan's shoulders. Ye Lan trembled for a moment but did not object.
Gao Shan said in a deep voice: "Ye Lan is a very simple person. She may have never thought about anything about men and women. The reason why she can talk to me is because I am very natural and have no evil thoughts. But you regard me as a thorn in your side and a thorn in your flesh; who do you think you are? Freedom of love, not even parents can Intervene. Because of this, Lan Lan was actually pushed towards me step by step because of this rebellious mentality. Otherwise, how could you have deliberately tried to get me out of the Second Affiliated Hospital? It's a pity that if I didn't want to leave, neither you nor Feng Zhonghua would be able to drive me away today. "
Having said this, Gao Shan walked up to Zhao Ruichen with disdain written all over his face. He patted Zhao Ruichen's clothes and said, "I really thought you were so awesome. I'm just cooperating with you. I feel like I'm the best in the world. Remember, it's you, Mr. Shan, who doesn't like the Second Affiliated Hospital. It's not that the Second Affiliated Hospital doesn't want me."
Ye Lan was fascinated, looking at the mountains with an inexplicably complicated expression. But there was a feeling of confidant in my heart. The way she looked at Gao Shan changed somewhat, because Gao Shan understood her.
When Zhao Ruichen saw Ye Lan's obsessed eyes, he immediately felt uncomfortable and sneered: "Yes, it's a pity that you are an idiot. You chose to study Chinese medicine. I want to see what you can do."
Gao Shan is so angry that he can't bear itMing smiled softly: "It doesn't matter if you can't get out. I have Mr. Cheng to take care of me. How can I be worse. Besides, I have to thank you, otherwise how could Lan Lan like me."
This was a bit brazen, even a bit excessive. Because at this moment Gao Shan felt like he was using Ye Lan as a tool to show off. But under this situation, especially when Zhao Ruichen is about to explode, it is not so conspicuous.
Even Ye Lan was a little flustered by Gao Shan's explicit words one after another, and didn't care at all what Gao Shan said.
"Fuck you!"
Zhao Ruichen roared, and under Gao Shan's provocation, he finally couldn't hold back the roar in his heart and rushed towards Gao Shan with his fists waving.
As he moved, two of the boys following him also rushed forward. Gao Shan's lips curled up. Can't help but take action? Not to mention three people, he wasn't afraid of five.
Not to mention that Gao Shan has practiced the Taichu Health Sutra, even if he didn't, Gao Shan, who has practiced in the countryside since he was a child, is not comparable to hothouse flowers like Zhao Ruichen. If you are a junior high school student or a technical school student in a mixed society. There will also be worries about the mountains. These kids don't care who you are. They just take the knife and do it. They really dare to stab you. But the ones in front of me are different. These people just look scary.
Nanya Medical College is a national first-class undergraduate program, and those who can get into it are not only well-behaved children, but at least they are good students who are not bad at studying. Although I have gained some training during my college years, I am still a student after all. When most people fight, they will close their eyes and wave their fists when someone goes up to them. As for where and why the fists were struck, in fact they were all random strikes.
But Gao Shan was different. Gao Shan was very calm. He saw the right moment, stretched out his foot, and trapped one of them. There were drinks everywhere on the floor of the box, and it was extremely slippery. With just one trip, one of them immediately fell to the ground. At the same time, he turned around and followed the other person's arm.
It was as if that person was waiting for him with his hand outstretched. But Gao Shan pressed down with his whole body and made the other party turn in one direction.
At the same time, Gao Shan moved his hands forward to meet Zhao Ruichen's fist. He grabbed and buckled Zhao Ruichen's left hand with one hand and twisted it. Zhao Ruichen wailed. His left hand had reached behind his back, and his whole body was bent. Immediately afterwards, Gao Shan's other hand also grabbed Zhao Ruichen's right shoulder. He raised his foot and stepped on Zhao Ruichen's knee, causing Zhao Ruichen to kneel down.
"Come on!" Gao Shan roared, looking at the two people who were about to move with wide eyes, and said: "If he dares to move, let him lie down!"
Not to mention the rabble led by Zhao Ruichen. Even if the big boss of mixed society is controlled, the younger brothers will not dare to act rashly until they find a good opportunity.
Alpine finger force, this is a technique. Gao Shan actually pressed Zhao Ruichen's acupuncture points, which immediately made Zhao Ruichen scream. The swelling and pain was simply unbearable for him.
"Gao. If you dare, kill me." Zhao Ruichen gritted his teeth and said in the midst of the severe pain.
